{{Top|leg}}
The '''Room of Dreams''' was a room that was located inside the [[Temple of Pain]], a [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]] situated within the [[Tascollan Nebula/Legends|Tascollan Nebula]]. Individuals who entered the room would be subjected to a waking dream by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], tempting them to give in to the dark side.
